		end
	end)
	v_u_36.selected:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (ref) v_u_3
		if #v_u_36.dropdownIcons > 0 then
			if v_u_3:GetCore("ChatActive") and v_u_36.alignment ~= "Right" then
				v_u_36.chatWasPreviouslyActive = true
				v_u_3:SetCore("ChatActive", false)
			end
			if v_u_3:GetCoreGuiEnabled("PlayerList") and v_u_36.alignment ~= "Left" then
				v_u_36.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive = true
				v_u_3:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, false)
			end
		end
	end)
	v_u_36.deselected:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36, (ref) v_u_3
		if v_u_36.chatWasPreviouslyActive then
			v_u_36.chatWasPreviouslyActive = nil
			v_u_3:SetCore("ChatActive", true)
		end
		if v_u_36.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive then
			v_u_36.playerlistWasPreviouslyActive = nil
			v_u_3:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, true)
		end
	end)
	task.delay(0.1, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_36
		if v_u_36.activeState == "Deselected" then
			v_u_36.stateChanged:Fire("Deselected")
			v_u_36:refresh()
		end
	end)
	v_u_12.iconAdded:Fire(v_u_36)
	return v_u_36
end

	p64.widget.Name = p65

function v_u_12.setState(p66, p67, p68, p69) -- name: setState
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_16
	local v70 = p67 or (p66.isSelected and "Selected" or "Deselected")
	local v71 = v_u_8.formatStateName(v70)
	if p66.activeState ~= v71 then
		local v72 = p66.isSelected
		p66.activeState = v71
		if v71 == "Deselected" then
			p66.isSelected = false
			if v72 then
				p66.toggled:Fire(false, p68, p69)
				p66.deselected:Fire(p68, p69)
			end
			p66:_setToggleItemsVisible(false, p68, p69)
		elseif v71 == "Selected" then
			p66.isSelected = true
			if not v72 then
				p66.toggled:Fire(true, p68, p69)
				p66.selected:Fire(p68, p69)
				v_u_16:Fire(p66, p68, p69)
			end
			p66:_setToggleItemsVisible(true, p68, p69)
		end
		p66.stateChanged:Fire(v71, p68, p69)
	end
end
function v_u_12.getInstance(p_u_73, p_u_74) -- name: getInstance
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9
	local v75 = p_u_73.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_74]
	if v75 then
		return v75
	end
	local function v_u_79(p_u_76, p_u_77) -- name: cacheInstance
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_73
		if not p_u_73.cachedInstances[p_u_77] then
			local v78 = p_u_77:GetAttribute("Collective")
			if v78 then
				v78 = p_u_73.cachedCollectives[v78]
			end
			if v78 then
				table.insert(v78, p_u_77)
			end
			p_u_73.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_76] = p_u_77
			p_u_73.cachedInstances[p_u_77] = true
			p_u_77.Destroying:Once(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_73, (copy) p_u_76, (copy) p_u_77
				p_u_73.cachedNamesToInstances[p_u_76] = nil
				p_u_73.cachedInstances[p_u_77] = nil
			end)
		end
	end
	local v80 = p_u_73.widget
	v_u_79("Widget", v80)
	if p_u_74 == "Widget" then
		return v80
	end
	local v_u_81 = nil
	local function v_u_87(p82) -- name: scanChildren
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_73, (ref) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_87, (copy) v_u_79, (copy) p_u_74, (ref) v_u_81
		for _, v83 in pairs(p82:GetChildren()) do
			local v84 = v83:GetAttribute("WidgetUID")
			if v84 and v84 ~= p_u_73.UID then
				continue
			end
			local v85 = v_u_9.getRealInstance(v83) or v83
			v_u_87(v85)
			if not (v85:IsA("GuiBase") or (v85:IsA("UIBase") or v85:IsA("ValueBase"))) then
				continue
			end
			local v86 = v85.Name
			v_u_79(v86, v85)
			if v86 ~= p_u_74 then
				continue
			end
			v_u_81 = v85
		end
	end
	v_u_87(v80)
	return v_u_81
end

local function v_u_143(p135, p136) -- name: facingYaw

		v56 = false

function v_u_3.describe(p65) -- name: describe

	local v66 = p65:FindFirstChild("Oil", true)

function v_u_3.stepPose(p72) -- name: stepPose
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v73 = p72 % 1
	if v73 < v_u_2.UnfoldEnd then
		local v74 = 0
		local v75 = v73 / v_u_2.UnfoldEnd
		local v76
		if v75 < 0.5 then
			v76 = v75 * 4 * v75 * v75
		else
			local v77 = v75 * -2 + 2
			v76 = 1 - v77 * v77 * v77 / 2
		end
		return v74, 1 - v76
	end
	if v73 < v_u_2.RiseStart then
		return 0, 0
	end
	if v73 < v_u_2.RiseEnd then
		local v78 = (v73 - v_u_2.RiseStart) / (v_u_2.RiseEnd - v_u_2.RiseStart)
		local v79
		if v78 < 0.5 then
			v79 = v78 * 4 * v78 * v78
		else
			local v80 = v78 * -2 + 2
			v79 = 1 - v80 * v80 * v80 / 2
		end
		return v79, 0
	end
	if v73 >= v_u_2.TipEnd then
		if v73 < v_u_2.FallStart then
			return 1, 1
		end
		local v81 = (v73 - v_u_2.FallStart) / (1 - v_u_2.FallStart)
		local v82
		if v81 < 0.5 then
			v82 = v81 * 4 * v81 * v81
		else
			local v83 = v81 * -2 + 2
			v82 = 1 - v83 * v83 * v83 / 2
		end
		return 1 - v82, 1
	end
	local v84 = 1
	local v85 = (v73 - v_u_2.RiseEnd) / (v_u_2.TipEnd - v_u_2.RiseEnd)
	if v85 < 0.5 then
		return v84, v85 * 4 * v85 * v85
	end
	local v86 = v85 * -2 + 2
	return v84, 1 - v86 * v86 * v86 / 2
end

end

function v_u_3.drawnPose(p100) -- name: drawnPose
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v101 = p100 % 1
	local v102 = v_u_2.RiseStart
	local v103 = v_u_2.RiseEnd
	local v104
	if v102 <= v103 then
		if v102 < v103 then
			local v105 = (v101 - v102) / (v103 - v102)
			v104 = math.clamp(v105, 0, 1)
		else
			v104 = v103 <= v101 and 1 or 0
		end
	else
		local v106 = (v101 - v102) % 1 / ((v103 - v102) % 1)
		v104 = math.clamp(v106, 0, 1)
	end
	local v107 = math.clamp(v104, 0, 1)
	local v108 = v107 * v107 * v107 * (v107 * (v107 * 6 - 15) + 10)
	local v109 = v_u_2.FallStart
	local v110 = v_u_2.FallEnd
	local v111
	if v109 <= v110 then
		if v109 < v110 then
			local v112 = (v101 - v109) / (v110 - v109)
			v111 = math.clamp(v112, 0, 1)
		else
			v111 = v110 <= v101 and 1 or 0
		end
	else
		local v113 = (v101 - v109) % 1 / ((v110 - v109) % 1)
		v111 = math.clamp(v113, 0, 1)
	end
	local v114 = math.clamp(v111, 0, 1)
	local v115 = v108 - v114 * v114 * v114 * (v114 * (v114 * 6 - 15) + 10)
	local v116
	if (v101 - v_u_2.UnfoldEnd) % 1 < (v_u_2.TipStart - v_u_2.UnfoldEnd) % 1 then
		local v117 = (v101 - v_u_2.UnfoldEnd) % 1 * v_u_2.Period
		local v118 = v_u_2.UnfoldBounce / v_u_2.TipAngle
		if v117 <= 0 or v_u_2.BounceSeconds * 8 < v117 then
			v116 = 0
		else
			local v119 = -v117 / v_u_2.BounceSeconds
			local v120 = v118 * math.exp(v119)
			local v121 = v_u_2.BounceRate * v117
			v116 = v120 * (1 - math.cos(v121))
		end
	elseif (v101 - v_u_2.TipStart) % 1 < (v_u_2.UnfoldStart - v_u_2.TipStart) % 1 then
		local v122 = v_u_2.TipStart
		local v123 = v_u_2.TipEnd
		local v124
		if v122 <= v123 then
			if v122 < v123 then
				local v125 = (v101 - v122) / (v123 - v122)
				v124 = math.clamp(v125, 0, 1)
			else
				v124 = v123 <= v101 and 1 or 0
			end
		else
			local v126 = (v101 - v122) % 1 / ((v123 - v122) % 1)
			v124 = math.clamp(v126, 0, 1)
		end
		local v127 = math.clamp(v124, 0, 1)
		local v128 = v127 * v127 * v127 * (v127 * (v127 * 6 - 15) + 10)
		local v129 = (v101 - v_u_2.TipEnd) % 1 * v_u_2.Period
		local v130 = v_u_2.TipBounce / v_u_2.TipAngle
		local v131
		if v129 <= 0 or v_u_2.BounceSeconds * 8 < v129 then
			v131 = 0
		else

			local v133 = v130 * math.exp(v132)
			local v134 = v_u_2.BounceRate * v129
			v131 = v133 * (1 - math.cos(v134))
		end
		v116 = v128 - v131
	else
		local v135 = v_u_2.UnfoldStart
		local v136 = v_u_2.UnfoldEnd
		local v137
		if v135 <= v136 then
			if v135 < v136 then
				local v138 = (v101 - v135) / (v136 - v135)
				v137 = math.clamp(v138, 0, 1)
			else
				v137 = v136 <= v101 and 1 or 0
			end
		else
			local v139 = (v101 - v135) % 1 / ((v136 - v135) % 1)
			v137 = math.clamp(v139, 0, 1)
		end
		local v140 = math.clamp(v137, 0, 1)
		v116 = 1 - v140 * v140 * v140 * (v140 * (v140 * 6 - 15) + 10)
	end
	return math.clamp(v115, 0, 1), v116
end

local function v_u_184(p175) -- name: heapLayers
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3

	local v177 = v_u_3.rowsBack(p175)

		end

	end

local function v_u_224(p195, p196) -- name: layout
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_194, (copy) v_u_184, (copy) v_u_1
	local v197 = v_u_194[p195]
	if not v197 then
		v197 = {}
		v_u_194[p195] = v197
	end
	local v198 = v197[p196]
	if v198 then
		return v198
	end
	local v199 = p196
	local v200 = {}
	for v201, v202 in v_u_184(p195) do
		if p196 <= 0 then
			break
		end

		local v204 = v202[1]

		local v207 = math.min(p196, v206)

			local v212 = math.min(v204, v211)

				if v203 == 0 then

				if v203 == 0 then

				end

				local v218 = v215 * v_u_1.TrayRowGap

			end
		end
		p196 = p196 - v207
	end

function v_u_3.decode(p278, p279) -- name: decode
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3
	local v280 = {}
	if typeof(p278) ~= "string" or p278 == "" then
		return v280
	end
	for _, v281 in string.split(p278, ",") do
		local v282 = string.split(v281, ":")
		local v283 = v282[1]
		local v284 = tonumber(v283)
		local v285 = v282[2]
		local v286 = tonumber(v285)
		local v287 = v282[3]
		local v288 = tonumber(v287)
		local v289 = v282[4]
		local v290 = tonumber(v289)
		local v291 = v282[5]
		local v292 = tonumber(v291)
		local v293 = v282[6]
		local v294 = tonumber(v293)
		local v295 = v282[7]
		local v296 = tonumber(v295)
		local v297 = v282[8]
		local v298 = tonumber(v297)
		local v299 = v282[9]
		local v300 = tonumber(v299)
		local v301 = v282[10]
		local v302 = tonumber(v301) or 0
		if not (v284 and (v286 and (v288 and (v290 and (v292 and (v294 and (v296 and (v298 and v300)))))))) then
			continue
		end
		for v303 = 0, math.min(v286, 1000) - 1 do
			local v304 = {
				["id"] = nil,
				["loadAt"] = nil,
				["slot"] = nil,
				["size"] = nil,
				["doneAt"] = nil,
				["exitAt"] = nil,
				["exitSlot"] = nil,
				["exitSize"] = nil,
				["fries"] = nil,
				["offset"] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
				["across"] = 0,
				["exitOffset"] = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
				["exitAcross"] = 0,
				["id"] = v284 + v303,
				["loadAt"] = v288,

	local v48

		v48 = 0

			break

function v_u_7.place(p164, p165, p166) -- name: place
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	local v167 = p165 * CFrame.new(0, p164.wheelRadius - p164.restRadius, 0)
	local v168 = p164.groups
	local v169 = {
		["wheelL"] = CFrame.Angles(-(p166.roll - p166.spinRoll), 0, 0),
		["wheelR"] = CFrame.Angles(-(p166.roll + p166.spinRoll), 0, 0),
		["body"] = CFrame.Angles(-p166.lean, 0, 0) * CFrame.new(0, p166.bob, 0),
		["head"] = CFrame.Angles(0, p166.headYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(p166.headPitch, 0, 0),
		["carry"] = CFrame.Angles(p166.basketTip * v_u_5.PourLift, 0, 0),
		["armL"] = CFrame.Angles(p166.armL, 0, 0),
		["armR"] = CFrame.Angles(p166.armR, 0, 0),
		["box"] = CFrame.new(0, -p166.boxDrop, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-p166.basketTip, 0, 0)
	}
	local v170 = CFrame.Angles(p166.antennaX, 0, p166.antennaZ)
	for _, v171 in p164.order do
		local v172 = v168[v171]
		local v173
		if v172.parent then

		else
			v173 = v167
		end
		v172.world = v173 * v172.joint * (v169[v171] or v170) * v172.joint:Inverse()
	end
	local v174 = p164.groupOf
	local v175 = p164.rests
	local v176 = p164.cframes

		v176[v177] = v168[v174[v177]].world * v175[v177]

function v_u_10.perkChips(p131, p132, p133) -- name: perkChips
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_67, (copy) v_u_99, (copy) v_u_8
	local v134 = {
		["gain"] = {},
		["cost"] = {}
	}
	local v135 = v_u_4.Draft.Cards[p132]
	if not v135 then
		return v134
	end
	local v136 = v_u_10.perkStacks(p131, p132)
	local v137 = { v135.Up }
	if v135.Down then
		local v138 = v135.Down
		table.insert(v137, v138)
	end
	for _, v139 in v135.Also or {} do
		table.insert(v137, v139)
	end
	for _, v140 in v137 do
		local v141 = v_u_4.Draft.Stats[v140.Stat]
		if not v141 then
			continue
		end
		local v142
		if p133 then
			v142 = v140.Amount * v136
		else
			v142 = v_u_67(p131, v140.Stat, p132) - v_u_67(p131, v140.Stat, nil)
		end
		local v143
		if v142 == 0 then
			v143 = v140.Amount
		else
			v143 = v142
		end
		local v144 = v143 * (v141.Better or 1) >= 0
		local v145 = v141.Chip
		local v146 = not v141.Add
		if v146 then
			v146 = not v141.Per
		end
		local v147 = math.abs(v142) * (v141.Add and 1 or (not v141.Per and 100 or v141.Per))
		local v148 = math.round(v147)
		local v149
		if v140 == v135.Up then
			v149 = v_u_99(p131, v135, not p133 and 1 or v136)
		else
			v149 = nil
		end
		if v149 then
			v146 = false
		else
			v149 = v148
		end
		local v150
		if v145 and (v145.Word and v144) then
			v150 = {
				["Stat"] = nil,
				["Text"] = nil,
				["Kind"] = "Word",
				["Stat"] = v140.Stat,
				["Text"] = v145.Word
			}
		else
			v150 = {
				["Stat"] = v140.Stat,
				["Text"] = (v144 and "+" or "-") .. v149 .. (v146 and "%" or ""),
				["Kind"] = v144 and "Gain" or "Cost"
			}
			local v151
			if v145 and v145.Label then
				local v152 = v145.Label
				v151 = v_u_8.f(v152, {
					["n"] = v149
				})
			else
				v151 = nil
			end
			v150.Label = v151
		end
		local v153
		if v144 then
			v153 = v134.gain
		else
			v153 = v134.cost
		end
		table.insert(v153, v150)
	end
	return v134
end

function v_u_10.perkMaxed(p165, p166) -- name: perkMaxed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_67
	local v167 = v_u_4.Draft
	local v168 = v167.Cards[p166]
	if not v168 or v_u_10.perkStacks(p165, p166) >= v168.Max then
		return true
	end
	local v169, v170 = v_u_10.perkGain(p165, p166)
	local v171 = v169 * (v167.Stats[v168.Up.Stat].Better or 1)
	local v172 = v168.Up.Amount
	if v171 < math.abs(v172) * v167.MinShare - 1e-6 then
		return true
	end
	if v168.Down ~= nil then
		local v173 = math.abs(v170 or 0)
		local v174 = v168.Down.Amount
		if v173 < math.abs(v174) * v167.MinShare - 1e-6 then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, v175 in v168.Also or {} do
		local v176 = v_u_67(p165, v175.Stat, p166) - v_u_67(p165, v175.Stat, nil)
		local v177 = math.abs(v176)
		local v178 = v175.Amount
		if v177 >= math.abs(v178) * v167.MinShare - 1e-6 then
			continue
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function v_u_10.draftEligible(p184, p185) -- name: draftEligible
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_1
	local v186 = v_u_4.Draft.Cards[p185]
	if not v186 or v_u_10.perkMaxed(p184, p185) then
		return false
	end
	if v186.MinDay and v_u_10.dayNumber() < v186.MinDay then
		return false
	end
	local v187 = v186.Tool
	if v187 and (v_u_10.ownsTool(p184, v187) or v_u_10.ownsBetterTool(p184, v187)) then
		return false
	end
	local v188 = v186.Requires
	if v188 == "Machine" then
		return v_u_10.machinesOwned() > 0
	end
	if v188 == "Robots" then
		local v189 = v_u_3:FindFirstChild("Tycoon")
		local v190
		if v189 == nil then
			v190 = false
		else
			v190 = v189:GetAttribute("Owned_Robots") == true
		end
		return v190
	end
	if v188 == "RobotRoom" then
		local v191 = v_u_3:FindFirstChild("Tycoon")
		local v192
		if v191 == nil or (v191:GetAttribute("Owned_Robots") ~= true or v_u_10.teamPerk("Robots") >= v_u_4.Draft.Stats.Robots.Max - 1e-6) then
			v192 = false
		else
			v192 = v_u_10.robotCount() < #v_u_4.Robot.Names
		end
		return v192
	end
	if v188 == "CashBoost" then
		return v_u_10.upgradeLevel(p184, "MoneyMulti") > 0
	end
	if v188 == "PowerFixed" then
		return v_u_3:GetAttribute("PowerFixedOnce") == true
	end
	if v188 == "Tool" then
		return v_u_10.tool(p184) ~= "Hand"
	end
	if v188 == "Vacuum" then
		for v193, v194 in v_u_4.Tools.Items do
			if not (v194.Vacuums and v_u_10.ownsTool(p184, v193)) then
				continue
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	if v188 == "Lives2" then
		local v195 = p184:GetAttribute("Lives")
		local v196
		if v_u_10.maxLives(p184) >= 2 and typeof(v195) == "number" then
			v196 = v195 >= 2
		else
			v196 = false
		end
		return v196
	end
	if v188 == "LifeRoom" then
		return v_u_10.maxLives(p184) < v_u_10.topLives()
	end
	if v188 == "Team" then
		for _, v197 in v_u_1:GetPlayers() do
			if v197 == p184 or (v197:GetAttribute("RunResult") ~= nil or v197:GetAttribute("GameOver") == true) then
				continue
			end
			return true
		end
		return false
	end
	if v188 ~= "SlowPeel" then
		return true
	end
	local v198 = not v_u_10.instantPeelUpgrade(p184)
	if v198 then
		v198 = not v_u_10.diamondPeeler(p184)
	end
	return v198
end

function v_u_17.step(p210, p211, p212) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_169, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_29, (copy) v_u_159, (copy) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_195, (copy) v_u_209
	local v213 = math.min(p211, 0.1)
	local v214 = os.clock()
	if p210.model.Parent and (p212 and (p212 - p210.centre).Magnitude <= v_u_12.CullDistance) then
		local v215 = p210.model:GetAttribute("Running") == true
		p210.clock = p210.clock + v213
		v_u_159(p210, v214)
		while p210.waitingBites[1] and v214 - p210.waitingBites[1] > 0.35 do

		end
		local v216
		if v215 then
			v216 = v214 - p210.lastWork < v_u_12.IdleDelay
		else
			v216 = v215
		end
		p210.rollerLevel = p210.rollerLevel + ((v215 and 1 or 0) - p210.rollerLevel) * v_u_5.smooth(v_u_12.RollerEase, v213)
		if not v215 and p210.rollerLevel < 0.001 then
			p210.rollerLevel = 0
		end
		p210.rollerAngle = (p210.rollerAngle + p210.rollerSpin * p210.rollerLevel * v213) % 6.283185307179586
		p210.floor.carry = p210.direction * (v_u_11.RollerSpeed * p210.rollerLevel)
		local v217 = p210.reelSpeed
		if v216 then
			v217.target = v_u_11.BladeSpin
			local v218 = v_u_12.SpinUpSpeed
			local v219 = v_u_12.SpinUpDamping
			v217.speed = v218
			v217.damping = v219
		else
			v217.target = not v215 and 0 or v_u_11.BladeSpin * v_u_12.IdleShare
			v217.speed = v_u_12.WindDownSpeed
			v217.damping = 1
		end
		local v220 = v217:step(v213)
		local v221 = math.max(v220, 0)
		local v222 = v217.target == 0 and v221 < 0.01 and 0 or v221
		p210.reelAngle = (p210.reelAngle + v222 * v213) % 6.283185307179586
		local v223 = v222 / v_u_11.BladeSpin
		local v224 = p210.shudder:step(v213)
		local v225 = 2 * v_u_12.HumShake * math.min(v223, 1.5)
		local v226 = v_u_12.StillShake < v225 and true or v224.Magnitude > v_u_12.StillShake
		local v227 = CFrame.identity
		if v226 then
			local v228 = p210.clock * v_u_12.HumRate
			local v229 = math.noise(v228, 0.5)
			local v230 = math.noise(v228, 3.7)
			local v231 = math.noise
			local v232 = Vector3.new(v229, v230, v231(v228, 9.1)) * v225
			local v233 = v224:Dot(p210.across)
			local v234 = v_u_12.ShudderRoll
			local v235 = v233 * math.rad(v234)
			v227 = CFrame.new(p210.base + v232 + v224) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(p210.direction, v235) * CFrame.new(-p210.base)
		end
		local v236 = v226 or p210.housingShaken
		p210.housingShaken = v226
		local v237 = p210.frameParts
		local v238 = p210.frameCFrames
		table.clear(v237)
		table.clear(v238)
		if p210.rollerLevel > 0 then
			for v239, v240 in p210.rollerRests do
				local v241 = p210.rollerParts[v239]
				table.insert(v237, v241)
				local v242 = v240 * CFrame.Angles(p210.rollerSigns[v239] * p210.rollerAngle, 0, 0)
				table.insert(v238, v242)
			end
		end
		local v243 = p210.reel
		if v243 and (v222 > 0 or v236) then
			local v244 = v227 * CFrame.new(v243.centre) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v243.axle, p210.spinSign * p210.reelAngle)
			for v245, v246 in v243.offsets do

				table.insert(v237, v247)
				local v248 = v244 * v246
				table.insert(v238, v248)
			end
		end
		if v236 then
			for v249, v250 in p210.shakenRests do
				local v251 = p210.shakenParts[v249]
				table.insert(v237, v251)
				local v252 = v227 * v250
				table.insert(v238, v252)
			end
		end
		if #v237 > 0 then
			v_u_3:BulkMoveTo(v237, v238, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
			p210.displaced = true
		end
		v_u_195(p210, v215, v216, v_u_3:GetAttribute("PowerOut") ~= true, v213)
		v_u_209(p210, v223)
	else
		v_u_169(p210)
		table.clear(p210.waitingBites)
		table.clear(v_u_27)

local function v_u_22(p5, p6, p7, p8, p9, p10, p11, p12) -- name: bar
	local v13 = p8 - p7
	local v14 = v13.Unit
	local v15 = (Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) - v14 * (Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)):Dot(v14)).Unit
	local v16 = v14:Cross(v15)

	v19.CastShadow = true
	v19.Shape = Enum.PartType.Block
	local v20 = p6 * CFrame.fromMatrix((p7 + p8) / 2, v16, v14, v15)

end
local function v_u_41(p23, p24, p25, p26, p27, p28, p29, p30, p31, p32, p33) -- name: blade

local function v_u_271(p251, p252, p253) -- name: fallPose

function v_u_20.step(p272) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_81, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_134, (copy) v_u_271, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_250
	local v273 = p272.origin
	local v274 = CFrame.identity
	local v275 = nil
	local v276 = false
	local v277 = 0
	local v278 = p272.unlockAt
	local v279 = p272.fall
	if v278 and v279 then
		local v280 = v_u_2:GetServerTimeNow() - v278
		if p272.doneAt <= v280 then
			return false
		end
		local v281 = v273.Position
		local v282 = v_u_8.Sounds
		local v283 = v273 * p272.keyhole

		end
		local v284 = v_u_8.Nudge * v_u_20.wobble(v280 - v_u_11, {
			["Hz"] = 9,
			["Damping"] = 0.4
		})
		local v285 = v_u_8.JoltDegrees
		local v286 = math.rad(v285) * v_u_20.wobble(v280 - v_u_13, v_u_8.Jolt)
		local v287 = 0.04 * v_u_20.wobble(v280 - v_u_15, {
			["Hz"] = 8,
			["Damping"] = 0.4
		})
		v273 = v273 * CFrame.new(0, -v287, v284) * p272.keyhole * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, v286) * p272.keyhole:Inverse()
		local v288 = v_u_20.wobble(v280 - v_u_13, {
			["Hz"] = 12,

		local v289 = math.abs(v288) * 0.03

						["volume"] = v282.Sparkle.volume,
						["pitch"] = v282.Sparkle.pitch
					})
				end
			end
			v289 = p272.pop * v_u_20.settle(v280 - v_u_15, v_u_8.Pop)
		end
		local v290 = v_u_8.SwingDegrees
		local v291 = math.rad(v290) * v_u_20.settle(v280 - v_u_16, v_u_8.Swing)
		v274 = CFrame.new(p272.legX, v289, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, v291, 0) * CFrame.new(-p272.legX, 0, 0)
		local v292
		if v_u_15 <= v280 then
			local v293 = v_u_8.FlashBrightness
			local v294 = -(v280 - v_u_15) * 7
			v292 = v293 * math.exp(v294)
		else
			v292 = 0
		end
		if v_u_18 <= v280 and v280 < v_u_19 then
			local v295 = v280 - v_u_18
			local v296 = v_u_8.TipSeconds
			local v297 = v295 / math.max(v296, 0.001)
			local v298 = v_u_134
			local v299 = v_u_8.TipDegrees
			v273 = v298(p272, math.rad(v299) * v297 * v297)
		elseif v_u_19 <= v280 then
			local v300 = v280 - v_u_19
			v273 = v_u_271(p272, v279, v300)
			local v301 = v279.hops[1]
			if v301.seconds <= v300 and not p272.played.land then
				p272.played.land = true
				if v300 - v301.seconds <= 0.25 then
					local v302 = (v273 * CFrame.new(0, p272.size.Y / 2, 0)).Position - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) * (p272.size.X / 2)
					v_u_6.play(v282.Land.Sound, v302, {
						["volume"] = v282.Land.volume,
						["pitch"] = v282.Land.pitch
					})
					local v303 = p272.dust.Parent
					if v303 and v303:IsA("BasePart") then
						v303.CFrame = CFrame.new(v302)
					end
					p272.dust:Emit(v_u_8.Dust)
				end
			end
			local v304 = v279.hops[2]
			if v304 then
				v_u_81(p272, "bounce", v300, v304.at + v304.seconds, v282.Bounce, (v273 * CFrame.new(0, p272.size.Y / 2, 0)).Position)
			end
			if v279.still + v_u_8.FadeAfter <= v300 then

local function v_u_125(p121, p122, p123) -- name: playMood
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_120, (copy) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_11
	p121.moodAt = p122
	local v124 = p121.mood

		p121.bob:impulse(v_u_10.HappyHop)
		p121.shimmerAt = p122
		return
	elseif v124 == "Surprised" then
		p121.pop:impulse(v_u_10.SurpriseKick)
		p121.bob:impulse(v_u_10.HappyHop * 0.6)
		p121.tilt:impulse(p121.tiltSign * v_u_10.SurpriseTilt * v_u_10.TiltSpeed)
		p121.tiltSign = -p121.tiltSign
		return
	elseif v124 == "Angry" then
		p121.pop:impulse(v_u_10.AngryKick)
		p121.tilt:impulse(p121.tiltSign * v_u_10.SurpriseTilt * v_u_10.TiltSpeed)
		p121.tiltSign = -p121.tiltSign
	elseif v124 == "Celebrate" then
		p121.pop:impulse(v_u_10.CelebrateKick)
		p121.bob:impulse(v_u_10.HappyHop)

		p121.rainbowAt = p122

		v_u_120(p121, p122, p123)

			v_u_65(p121, "dialogue_celebrate")
			return
		end
	elseif v124 == "Eerie" then
		p121.tearUntil = p122 + 0.12
		p121.tearX = v_u_11.TearWidth * p121.tiltSign
		p121.tiltSign = -p121.tiltSign
	end
end
local function v_u_132(p126, p127) -- name: corrupt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11
	local v128 = p126.rng
	if p126.nextGlitchAt <= p127 then
		p126.nextGlitchAt = p127 + v_u_11.GlitchEvery * v128:NextNumber(0.5, 1.5)
		if p126.typed > 0 and v128:NextNumber() < v_u_11.GlitchChance then
			local v129 = p126.buffer
			table.clear(v129)
			table.move(p126.graphemes, 1, p126.letters, 1, v129)
			local v130 = v_u_11.GlitchLetters
			for _ = 1, v128:NextInteger(1, (math.max(v130, 1))) do
				local v131 = v128:NextInteger(1, p126.typed)
				if v129[v131] == " " then
					continue
				end
				v129[v131] = v_u_11.Glyphs[v128:NextInteger(1, #v_u_11.Glyphs)]

		end

	end
end
function v_u_22.step(p133, p134, p135) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_125, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_14, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_132
	if not (p133.open or p133.closing) then
		return false
	end
	p133.near = p135
	local v136 = os.clock()
	local v137 = p133.rng
	local v138 = p133.s
	local v139 = p133.width:step(p134)
	local v140 = math.max(v139, 0.1)
	local v141 = p133.height:step(p134)
	local v142 = math.max(v141, 0.1)
	local v143 = v_u_10.TailHeight * v_u_10.TailTuck
	local v144 = v142 + v_u_10.TailHeight - v143
	local v145 = v142 / v144
	if p133.typing then
		local v146 = v136 - p133.typeAt
		local v147 = p133.graphemes
		local v148 = false
		while p133.typed < p133.letters and p133.revealAt[p133.typed + 1] <= v146 do
			p133.typed = p133.typed + 1
			local v149 = v147[p133.typed]
			local v150 = v147[p133.typed + 1]
			if v149 == " " then
				continue
			end
			p133.ticks = p133.ticks + 1
			if not v148 and (p135 and not p133.quiet) then
				local v151 = p133.ticks
				local v152 = v_u_10.TickEvery
				local v153 = v151 % math.max(v152, 1)
				local v154 = v_u_10.TickEvery
				if v153 == 1 % math.max(v154, 1) then
					v148 = true
					local v155
					if p133.glitch then
						v155 = v_u_11.TickPitch * (1 + v137:NextNumber(-1, 1) * v_u_11.TickJitter)
					else
						v155 = v_u_10.TickPitch * (1 + v137:NextNumber(-1, 1) * v_u_10.TickJitter)
					end
					v_u_65(p133, p133.tickSound, {
						["pitch"] = v155
					})
				end
			end
			if v_u_19[v149] or v_u_20[v149] then
				p133.hop:impulse(v_u_10.PunctuationHop)
				p133.pop:impulse(v_u_10.PunctuationKick)
			else
				if v150 ~= nil and v150 ~= " " then
					continue
				end
				p133.hop:impulse(v_u_10.WordHop)
			end
		end
		if p133.typed >= p133.letters then
			p133.typing = false
			p133.typedAt = v136
			v138.shown(-1)
			v_u_125(p133, v136, v145)
		else
			v138.shown(p133.typed)
		end
	elseif p133.open and (p133.holdSeconds > 0 and v136 - p133.typedAt >= p133.holdSeconds) then
		p133:close()
	end
	local v156 = p133.pop:step(p134)
	local v157 = p133.pop.velocity
	local v158 = p133.bob:step(p134)
	local v159 = p133.hop:step(p134)
	local v160 = p133.tilt:step(p134)
	local v161 = v157 * v_u_10.Squash
	local v162 = -v_u_10.SquashMax
	local v163 = v_u_10.SquashMax
	local v164 = -math.clamp(v161, v162, v163)
	local v165 = 1
	local v166 = 1
	local v167, v168, v169
	if p133.closing then
		local v170 = v136 - p133.closeAt
		local v171 = v_u_10.CloseSeconds
		local v172 = v170 / math.max(v171, 0.01)
		if v172 >= 1 then
			p133.closing = false
			p133.gui.Enabled = false
			p133.glitched = false

				v173.shown = false
				v173.visible(false)
			end

		end

		local v175 = 1 - v172 / math.max(v174, 0.01)
		v167 = math.max(0, v175)
		if p133.glitch then
			v168 = 1
			local v176 = 1 - v_u_2.outCubic(v172 / 0.6)
			v166 = math.max(v176, 0.03)
			v165 = 1 - v_u_2.outCubic((v172 - 0.6) / 0.4)
			if v172 > 0.6 and v137:NextNumber() < 0.3 then
				v169 = 0.3
			else
				v169 = 1
			end
		else
			local v177 = v_u_10.PuffShare
			local v178 = math.max(v177, 0.01)
			if v172 < v178 then
				v168 = 1 + (v_u_10.ClosePuff - 1) * v_u_2.outCubic(v172 / v178)
			else
				local v179 = v_u_10.ClosePuff
				local v180 = (v172 - v178) / (1 - v178)
				local v181 = math.clamp(v180, 0, 1)
				v168 = v179 * (1 - (v181 * 2.70158 * v181 * v181 - v181 * 1.70158 * v181))
			end
			local v182 = v172 - (1 - v_u_10.FadeShare)
			local v183 = v_u_10.FadeShare
			local v184 = v182 / math.max(v183, 0.01)
			v169 = 1 - math.clamp(v184, 0, 1)
		end
		v164 = 0
	else
		local v185 = v136 - p133.openAt
		local v186 = v_u_10.FadeSeconds
		local v187 = v185 / math.max(v186, 0.01)
		v169 = math.clamp(v187, 0, 1)
		if v185 < v_u_10.TailDelay then
			v167 = 0
		else
			local v188 = v_u_2.outBack
			local v189 = v185 - v_u_10.TailDelay
			local v190 = v_u_10.TailSeconds
			v167 = v188(v189 / math.max(v190, 0.01))
		end
		local v191 = v185 / 0.6
		local v192 = math.clamp(v191, 0, 1)
		local v193 = v136 * 2 * 3.141592653589793

local function v_u_106(p89) -- name: readRoute
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_7
	local v90 = p89.car
	local v91
	if p89.late > 0 then
		if p89.route ~= nil and not (p89.done or p89.lateRoute) then
			p89.lateRoute = true
			return
		end
		p89.late = 0
		v91 = true
	else
		v91 = false
	end
	p89.lateRoute = false
	local v92 = v90:GetAttribute("Route")
	local v93 = v90:GetAttribute("RouteStart")
	local v94 = v90:GetAttribute("RouteLift")
	p89.routeId = v90:GetAttribute("RouteId")
	if typeof(v92) == "string" and typeof(v93) == "number" then
		local v95 = p89.route ~= nil and not p89.done
		if v95 then
			v95 = v93 == p89.startAt
		end
		local v96 = not v95 and 0 or p89.rolled
		local v97 = v_u_7.build(v_u_7.decode(v92))
		p89.route = v97
		p89.startAt = v93
		p89.lift = typeof(v94) ~= "number" and 0 or v94
		p89.duration = v97.duration
		p89.along = 0
		p89.done = false
		p89.idle = false
		local _, _, _, _, _, _, v98 = v_u_7.poseAt(v97, v97.duration + 1)
		local v99 = v98 - v96
		for v100, v101 in p89.wheels do
			local v102 = not v95 and 0 or (p89.spinBase[v100] or 0) + v96 * (p89.spinPerStud[v100] or 0)
			local v103 = v101.radius
			local v104 = 1 / math.max(v103, 0.1)
			if math.abs(v99) > 1 then
				local v105 = (v102 + v99 * v104) / 6.283185307179586
				v104 = (math.round(v105) * 2 * 3.141592653589793 - v102) / v99
			end
			p89.spinPerStud[v100] = v104
			p89.spinBase[v100] = v102 - v96 * v104
		end
		v_u_26(v90, "Route", p89)
		if v91 then
			v_u_26(v90, "OnTime", p89)
		end
	else
		p89.route = nil
		if v91 then
			v_u_26(v90, "OnTime", p89)
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_114(p107, p108, p109, p110) -- name: stepLate
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_106, (copy) v_u_26
	if p107.done then
		p107.late = 0
		if p107.lateRoute then
			v_u_106(p107)
			local v111
			if p107.route then
				local v112 = p109 - p107.startAt
				v111 = math.max(v112, 0)
			else
				v111 = 0
			end
			p107.late = v111
		end
	elseif p107.moving and p109 - p107.startAt < p108.duration then
		local v113 = p107.late - p107.lateCatchUp * p110
		p107.late = math.max(v113, 0)
	end

		v_u_26(p107.car, "OnTime", p107)
	end
end

local function v_u_180(p144, p145, p146) -- name: draw
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_88, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_4
	if p144.dirty then
		v_u_88(p144)
	end
	local v147 = p144.pose
	local v148
	if p146 then
		v148 = v147
	else
		local v149 = p144.pitch:step(p145)
		local v150 = v_u_12.MaxPitch
		local v151 = -math.rad(v150) * 1.4
		local v152 = v_u_12.MaxPitch
		local v153 = math.rad(v152) * 1.4
		local v154 = math.clamp(v149, v151, v153)
		local v155 = p144.roll:step(p145)
		local v156 = v_u_12.MaxRoll
		local v157 = -math.rad(v156) * 1.3
		local v158 = v_u_12.MaxRoll
		local v159 = math.rad(v158) * 1.3
		local v160 = math.clamp(v155, v157, v159)
		local v161 = p144.heave:step(p145)
		local v162 = -v_u_12.MaxHeave
		local v163 = v_u_12.MaxHeave
		local v164 = math.clamp(v161, v162, v163)
		v148 = v147 * CFrame.new(0, v164, 0) * CFrame.Angles(v154, 0, v160)
	end
	local v165 = p144.moveParts
	local v166 = p144.moveCFrames
	local v167 = #p144.body
	for v168 = 1, v167 do
		v166[v168] = v148 * p144.bodyOffsets[v168]
	end
	local v169 = p144.rolled
	for v170, v171 in p144.wheels do
		local v172 = -((p144.spinBase[v170] or 0) + v169 * (p144.spinPerStud[v170] or 0))
		local v173
		if p144.frontWheel[v170] then
			v173 = CFrame.Angles(0, p144.drawnSteer, 0)
		else
			v173 = CFrame.identity
		end
		v166[v167 + v170] = v147 * CFrame.new(v171.offset.Position) * v173 * CFrame.Angles(v172, 0, 0) * v171.offset.Rotation
	end
	local v174 = p144.root
	local v175 = p144.rootIndex
	if v174 and (v175 and #p144.driverParts > 0) then
		local v176 = v166[v175] * v174.CFrame:Inverse()
		local v177 = v167 + #p144.wheels
		for v178, v179 in p144.driverParts do
			v166[v177 + v178] = v176 * v179.CFrame
		end
	end

end

function v14.start() -- name: start

local function v_u_241(p238, p239) -- name: playMood
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_20
	p238.moodAt = p239
	local v240 = p238.line.mood
	if v240 == "Happy" then
		p238.bob:impulse(v_u_19.HappyHop)
		p238.shimmerAt = p239
		return
	elseif v240 == "Surprised" then
		p238.kick:impulse(v_u_19.SurpriseKick)
		p238.bob:impulse(v_u_19.HappyHop * 0.6)
		p238.tilt:impulse(p238.tiltSign * v_u_19.SurpriseTilt * v_u_19.TiltSpeed)
		p238.tiltSign = -p238.tiltSign
		return
	elseif v240 == "Angry" then
		p238.kick:impulse(v_u_19.AngryKick)
		p238.tilt:impulse(p238.tiltSign * v_u_19.SurpriseTilt * v_u_19.TiltSpeed)
		p238.tiltSign = -p238.tiltSign

local function v_u_106(p99, p100, p101) -- name: makeViewItem
	local v102 = p101 or 1
	local v103 = {
		["root"] = p99,
		["parts"] = {},
		["offsets"] = {},
		["sizes"] = {},
		["fullSize"] = p99.Size / v102,

	for _, v104 in p99:GetDescendants() do

			local v105 = p99.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(v104.CFrame)

			v103.offsets[#v103.offsets + 1] = CFrame.new(v105.Position / v102) * v105.Rotation

			v104.CanQuery = false

		end
	end
	p99.Name = p100
	p99.Anchored = true

	p99.CanTouch = false
	p99.CastShadow = false

end

local function v_u_264(p202, p203) -- name: stepToss
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_41, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_113, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_23
	local v204 = p202.plan
	local v205 = p203 - p202.startedAt
	local v206 = v204.flight
	local v207 = math.min(v205, v206)
	local v208 = v_u_41.D.LeaveSeconds
	local v209 = v204.flight
	local v210 = math.min(v208, v209)
	local v211 = v205 / math.max(v210, 0.001)
	local v212 = math.clamp(v211, 0, 1)
	local v213 = v_u_13.at(v204, v207)
	if v212 < 1 then
		local v214 = p202.from + p202.lead
		v213 = p202.from * ((1 - v212) * (1 - v212)) + v214 * (v212 * 2 * (1 - v212)) + v213 * (v212 * v212)
	end
	local v215 = CFrame.new(v213) * p202.rotation * CFrame.Angles(v207 * 9, 0, v207 * 6)
	local v216 = p202.item
	if v212 < 1 or v216.scale ~= 1 then
		local v217 = p202.fromScale + (p202.viewScale - p202.fromScale) * v_u_10.outBack(v212)
		local v218 = (v213 - p202.eye).Magnitude
		local v219 = (p202.from - p202.eye).Magnitude
		local v220 = v217 * (v218 / math.max(v219, 0.05))
		local v221 = math.min(v220, 1)
		local v222 = 1 - v221
		local v223 = (v205 - v_u_41.D.LeaveSeconds) / v_u_41.D.GrowSeconds
		local v224 = v221 + v222 * math.clamp(v223, 0, 1)
		local v225 = p202.blendAt
		if v225 then
			local v226 = 1 - v224
			local v227 = v_u_10.inOutCubic
			local v228 = (p203 - v225) / v_u_41.D.BlendSeconds
			v224 = v224 + v226 * v227((math.clamp(v228, 0, 1)))
		end
		local v229 = p202.stretch * (1 - v212) * (1 - v212)
		local v230 = v229 + 1
		local v231 = 1 - v229 * 0.4
		local v232 = 1 - v229 * 0.4
		local v233 = Vector3.new(v230, v231, v232)
		v216.root.Size = v216.fullSize * v224 * (v233 or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1))
		if v216.scale ~= v224 then
			v216.scale = v224
			for v234, v235 in v216.parts do
				v235.Size = v216.sizes[v234] * v224
			end
		end
	end
	local v236 = p202.trail
	if v236 and v_u_41.D.ShotTrailSeconds < v205 then
		v236.Enabled = false
		p202.trail = nil
	elseif v236 then
		local v237 = v216.root.Size.Y * 0.3
		local v238 = v236.Attachment0

function v_u_56.slot(p120, p121, p122) -- name: slot
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_26, (copy) v_u_76, (copy) v_u_80, (copy) v_u_78, (copy) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_81
	local v123 = v_u_26.scale()
	local v124 = v_u_76() / v123
	local v125 = v_u_80() - v_u_78()
	local v126 = math.max(v125, 0) / v123 + v_u_27.TopBarGap
	local v127 = v124 - v_u_27.RightClear
	local v128 = (v_u_81() - v_u_78()) / v123 - v_u_27.TopBarGap
	local v129 = math.min(v127, v128)
	if p122 then
		local v130 = v129 - v124 / 2
		local v131 = v124 / 2 - v126
		local v132 = math.min(v130, v131) * 2 / p120
		if p121 * v_u_27.MinFit <= v132 then
			return 0, math.min(v132, p121), false
		else
			return 0, p121, true
		end
	else

		local v134 = p121 * v_u_27.MinFit
		local v135 = math.clamp(v133, v134, p121)

	end
end

end

function v_u_43.finish(p464, p465, p466) -- name: finish

local function v_u_754(p724, p725, p726, p727) -- name: layoutMirrors
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32
	local v728 = {}
	if p725 <= 0 then
		return v728, v_u_32.P.MirrorScale
	end
	local v729 = p724.ViewportSize
	local v730 = v729.Y <= 1 and 1.7777777777777777 or v729.X / v729.Y
	local v731 = -v_u_32.P.Offset.Z
	local v732 = math.max(v731, 0.5)
	local v733 = math.rad(p727) * 0.5
	local v734 = math.tan(v733) * v730 * 0.96
	local v735 = p725 / 2
	local v736 = math.ceil(v735)
	local v737 = 0
	local v738 = 0
	local v739 = 1
	for _ = 1, 30 do
		local v740 = p726 * v_u_32.P.MirrorScale * v739
		local v741 = v_u_32.P.MirrorSpacing * v739
		local v742 = p726 + v740 + v_u_32.P.MirrorGap
		v738 = math.max(v741, v742)
		local v743 = v_u_32.P.MirrorSpacing * v739
		local v744 = v740 * 2 + v_u_32.P.MirrorGap
		v737 = math.max(v743, v744)
		local v745 = v738 + (v736 - 1) * v737
		local v746 = v745 / v732
		local v747 = math.atan(v746)
		local v748 = v745 * v745 + v732 * v732
		local v749 = v740 / math.sqrt(v748)
		local v750 = math.min(v749, 1)
		local v751 = v747 + math.asin(v750)
		if v751 < 1.5 and math.tan(v751) <= v734 then
			break
		end
		v739 = v739 * 0.93
	end
	for v752 = 1, p725 do
		local v753 = (v752 % 2 == 1 and 1 or -1) * (v738 + ((v752 + 1) // 2 - 1) * v737)
		v728[v752] = Vector3.new(v753, 0, 0)
	end
	return v728, v_u_32.P.MirrorScale * v739
end

local function v_u_182(p164, p165) -- name: markPeeled
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_21

		return false
	end

	local v169 = v167 * 64
	local v170 = math.floor(v169)
	local v171 = v168 * 32
	local v172 = math.floor(v171)
	local v173 = math.clamp(v172, 0, 31)
	p164.points = p164.points + 1
	local v174 = p164.cells
	local v175 = v174[v173 * 64 + v170 % 64]
	local v176 = v173 - 2
	local v177 = math.max(v176, 0)
	local v178 = v173 + 2

			end

		end
	end

end

function v_u_28.pickNear(p866, p867, p868, p869, p870) -- name: pickNear

	local v873 = {}

		local v875 = v_u_27.partCell[v874]

		v881.dist = v879

	end
	table.sort(v873, function(p884, p885)
		if p884.depth == p885.depth then
			return p884.dist < p885.dist
		else
			return p884.depth < p885.depth
		end
	end)
	local v886 = {}
	if p870 then
		v886[p870] = true
	end
	local v887 = {}
	for _, v888 in v873 do
		if p868 <= #v871 then
			break
		end

		local v890 = v_u_27.packKey(v889[1], v889[3])

	end
	if p869 and #v_u_27.moves <= v_u_24.FX.MaxMoves then
		local v896 = 0
		for _, v897 in v873 do
			if v_u_24.FX.Tremble <= v896 then
				break
			end
			local v898 = v897.part
			if v887[v898] or v_u_27.moveOf[v898] then

			end
			v896 = v896 + 1
			local v899 = v898.CFrame

function v_u_24.buildTunnel(p65) -- name: buildTunnel

function v_u_24.muteOne(p_u_239, p240, p241) -- name: muteOne

local function v_u_257(p249, p250) -- name: cues

local function v_u_266(p258, p259) -- name: pulse
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_26
	local v260 = 0
	for _, v261 in p258.pulses do

			continue

	end

local function v_u_347(p340, p341, p342, p343, p344) -- name: onCable
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44, (copy) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_52, (copy) v_u_178, (ref) v_u_55
	local v345
	if typeof(p340) == "Instance" then
		v345 = v_u_44[p340]
	else
		v345 = nil
	end
	if v345 then
		local v346 = v345.view
		if p341 == "Refused" then
			v_u_11.pulse("Refuse")
			if v_u_52 == v345 then
				v_u_178(false)
			end
			if v_u_55 == v345 then
				v_u_55 = nil
				return
			end
		else
			if v_u_52 == v345 or not v346 then
				return
			end
			if p341 == "Drag" and (typeof(p342) == "number" and (typeof(p343) == "number" and typeof(p344) == "number")) then
				v346.hand(p342, math.clamp(p343, 0, 1), (math.clamp(p344, 0, 1)))
				return
			end
			if p341 == "Zap" and typeof(p342) == "number" then
				v346.zap(p342, false)
			end
		end
	end
end
local function v_u_352(p348, p349) -- name: paidMe
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_43
	if p349 == v_u_43.UserId then
		return true
	end
	local v350 = p348.model:GetAttribute("PowerHelpers")
	if typeof(v350) == "string" then
		for v351 in string.gmatch(v350, "%-?%d+") do
			if tonumber(v351) ~= v_u_43.UserId then
				continue
			end
			return true
		end
	end
	return false

local function v_u_43(p_u_40) -- name: gate

		if p_u_40.MaxActivationDistance ~= 0 then
			v41.range = p_u_40.MaxActivationDistance
			p_u_40.MaxActivationDistance = 0
		end
	else
		local v_u_42 = {
			["range"] = nil,
			["watch"] = nil,
			["range"] = p_u_40.MaxActivationDistance
		}
		v_u_38[p_u_40] = v_u_42
		p_u_40.MaxActivationDistance = 0
		v_u_42.watch = p_u_40:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MaxActivationDistance"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_40, (copy) v_u_42

end

				["prompt"] = v57,

			p55.buttonDown = true

	end
end

local function v_u_71(p67, p68) -- name: billboardSpot
	local v69 = p67.Adornee
	local v70
	if v69 == nil then
		v70 = nil
	elseif v69:IsA("Attachment") then
		v70 = v69.WorldCFrame
	elseif v69:IsA("BasePart") then
		v70 = v69.CFrame
	elseif v69:IsA("Model") then
		v70 = v69:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		v70 = nil
	end
	if v70 then
		return v70:PointToWorldSpace(p67.StudsOffsetWorldSpace) + p68.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(p67.StudsOffset)
	else
		return nil
	end
end
local function v_u_91(p72) -- name: pillAt
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_71, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_8
	local v73 = v_u_6.CurrentCamera
	if not v73 then
		return nil
	end
	local v74 = (1 / 0)
	local v75 = nil
	for _, v76 in v_u_23 do
		local v77
		if v76.hideAt then
			v77 = nil
		else
			v77 = v_u_71(v76.gui, v73)
		end
		if not v77 then
			continue
		end
		local v78 = v73:WorldToScreenPoint(v77)
		local v79 = v76.gui.AbsoluteSize
		local v80 = v76.gui.SizeOffset
		local v81 = Vector2.new(v78.X + v80.X * v79.X, v78.Y - v80.Y * v79.Y)
		local v82 = v79.X / 2 + v_u_17.TouchPad
		local v83 = v_u_8.Ui.MinTouch / 2
		local v84 = math.max(v82, v83)
		local v85 = v79.Y / 2 + v_u_17.TouchPad
		local v86 = v_u_8.Ui.MinTouch / 2
		local v87 = math.max(v85, v86)
		local v88 = p72.X - v81.X
		local v89
		if math.abs(v88) <= v84 then
			local v90 = p72.Y - v81.Y
			v89 = math.abs(v90) <= v87
		else
			v89 = false
		end
		if not v89 or (v78.Z <= 0 or v78.Z >= v74) then
			continue
		end
		v74 = v78.Z
		v75 = v76
	end
	return v75
end

local function v_u_107(p100) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_27
	local v101 = os.clock()
	local v102 = nil
	for v103 = #v_u_24, 1, -1 do
		local v104 = v_u_24[v103]
		if v_u_15.step(v104, p100, v101) then
			if not v104.holding or (v104.holdSeconds <= 0 or v104.fill >= 1) then
				continue
			end
			local v105 = v104.fill
			v102 = math.max(v102 or 0, v105)
		else
			v_u_24[v103] = v_u_24[#v_u_24]
			v_u_24[#v_u_24] = nil
			v104.gui.Parent = nil
			v104.gui.Adornee = nil
			v104.prompt = nil
			if #v_u_25 < v_u_17.PoolSize then
				local v106 = v_u_25
				table.insert(v106, v104)
			else
				v_u_15.destroy(v104)
			end
		end
	end
	if v102 then
		v_u_9.hold("PromptHold", v102)
	else
		v_u_9.release("PromptHold")
	end
	if #v_u_24 == 0 and v_u_27 then
		v_u_27:Disconnect()
		v_u_27 = nil
	end
end

		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_46, (ref) v_u_80, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_51, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_65, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_71, (ref) v_u_91, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_86, (ref) v_u_87, (ref) v_u_72, (ref) v_u_19

local function v_u_374(p323, p324, p325) -- name: poseOf

	local v328 = v327.Position
	local v329 = v327.Rotation

local function v_u_68(p52, p53) -- name: sweep
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_36, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_51, (copy) v_u_4
	local v54 = v_u_25[p52.door]
	if v54 and v54.out:Dot(p52.out) > 0.99 then
		return v54.clear
	end
	local v55 = OverlapParams.new()
	v55.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	v55.FilterDescendantsInstances = v_u_36(p52.door)
	local v56 = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * (2 * v_u_18.ClearMargin)
	local v57 = v_u_18.ClearMost
	local v58 = nil
	for v59 = v_u_18.ClearStep, v_u_18.ClearMost, v_u_18.ClearStep do
		for _, v60 in v_u_51(p52, p53, v59) do
			local v61 = (v60.size - v56):Max(Vector3.new(0.02, 0.02, 0.02))
			for _, v62 in v_u_4:GetPartBoundsInBox(v60.cframe, v61, v55) do
				local v63
				if v62.Transparency >= 0.98 or not v62.Anchored then
					v63 = false
				else
					local v64 = v62:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
					if v64 then
						v64 = v64:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					end
					v63 = not v64
				end
				if not v63 then
					continue
				end
				v58 = v62
			end
			if not v58 then
				break
			end
		end
		if not v58 then
			break
		end
		v57 = v59 - v_u_18.ClearStep
	end
	if v57 < v_u_18.MinAngle then
		local v65 = warn
		local v66 = "[TrickOrTreat] %* only swings out %* degrees (%* is in the way): using %*"
		local v67 = p52.door:GetFullName()
		if v58 then
			v58 = v58:GetFullName()
		end
		v65((v66:format(v67, v57, v58, v_u_18.MinAngle)))
	end
	v_u_25[p52.door] = {
		["out"] = p52.out,
		["clear"] = v57
	}
	return v57
end
function v_u_23.shape(p69, p70) -- name: shape
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_42, (copy) v_u_51, (copy) v_u_68
	local v71 = p69:GetAttribute("TreatBottom")
	local v72 = p69:GetAttribute("TreatHinge")
	local v73 = p69:GetAttribute("TreatHeight")
	if typeof(v71) ~= "Vector3" or (typeof(v72) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(v73) ~= "number") then
		return nil
	end
	local v74 = (v71 - v72) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
	if v74.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return nil
	end
	local v75 = v74.Unit
	local v76 = (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)):Cross(v75)
	if (p70 - v71):Dot(v76) < 0 then
		v76 = -v76

	local v79 = CFrame.fromMatrix(v71, (Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)):Cross(v76), Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), v76)
	local v80 = {
		["door"] = nil,
		["closed"] = nil,
		["bottom"] = nil,
		["hinge"] = nil,
		["height"] = nil,
		["out"] = nil,
		["across"] = nil,
		["turn"] = nil,
		["space"] = nil,
		["mirror"] = nil,
		["reach"] = 0,
		["clear"] = nil,
		["outward"] = nil,
		["angle"] = nil,
		["anomalyAngle"] = nil,
		["door"] = p69,
		["closed"] = v77,
		["bottom"] = v71,
		["hinge"] = v72,
		["height"] = v73,
		["out"] = v76,
		["across"] = v75,
		["turn"] = v78,
		["space"] = v79,
		["mirror"] = (v72 - v71):Dot(v79.RightVector) >= 0 and 1 or -1,
		["clear"] = v_u_18.ClearMost,
		["outward"] = v_u_18.Outward,
		["angle"] = v_u_18.Angle,
		["anomalyAngle"] = v_u_18.Anomaly.Open.Angle
	}
	local v81 = v_u_42(p69)
	for _, v82 in v_u_51(v80, v81, 0) do
		local v83 = v82.size / 2
		for _, v84 in {
			Vector3.new(1, 1, 1),
			Vector3.new(1, 1, -1),
			Vector3.new(1, -1, 1),
			Vector3.new(-1, 1, 1),
			Vector3.new(-1, -1, 1),
			Vector3.new(-1, 1, -1),
			Vector3.new(1, -1, -1),
			Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1)
		} do
			local v85 = v82.cframe:PointToWorldSpace(v83 * v84)
			local v86 = v80.reach
			local v87 = ((v85 - v72) * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
			v80.reach = math.max(v86, v87)
		end
	end
	v80.clear = v_u_68(v80, v81)
	local v88 = v_u_18.Outward
	if v88 then
		v88 = v80.clear >= v_u_18.MinAngle
	end
	v80.outward = v88
	local v89 = v80.clear
	local v90 = v_u_18.MinAngle
	local v91 = math.max(v89, v90)
	local v92 = v_u_18.Angle
	local v93 = v_u_18.Crack.Degrees + (v91 - v_u_18.Crack.Degrees) / v_u_18.Overshoot
	v80.angle = math.min(v92, v93)
	local v94 = v_u_18.Anomaly.Open.Angle
	v80.anomalyAngle = math.min(v94, v91)

end

local function v_u_118(p114) -- name: raps
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_13
	local v115 = v_u_18.Rap
	if p114 <= 0 or v115.Until <= p114 then
		return 0
	end
	local v116 = 0
	for _, v117 in v115.Hits do
		v116 = v116 + v_u_13.wobble(p114 - v117, v115)
	end
	return v115.Degrees * v116
end
local function v_u_132(p119, p120) -- name: friendAngle
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_7
	local v121 = v_u_17.Cinema.Beats.Friend
	local v122 = p120.t
	if p120.act == "A1" then
		local v123 = v121.A1
		local v124 = v_u_18.Latch.Degrees * v_u_13.wobble(v122 - v123.Latch, v_u_18.Latch)
		local v125 = v_u_18.Crack.Degrees
		if v123.Swing <= v122 then
			return v124 + v125 + (p119.angle - v125) * v_u_13.settle(v122 - v123.Swing, v_u_18.Spring)
		elseif v123.Crack <= v122 then
			return v124 + v125 * v_u_7.outCubic((v122 - v123.Crack) / v_u_18.Crack.Seconds)
		else
			return v124
		end
	else
		if p120.act == "Pick" then
			return p119.angle
		end
		local v126 = v121.A3
		if v122 < v126.Close then
			return p119.angle
		end
		if v122 >= v126.Contact then
			local v127 = v_u_18.Bounce.Degrees
			local v128 = v_u_13.wobble(v122 - v126.Contact, v_u_18.Bounce)
			return v127 * math.abs(v128)
		end
		local v129 = v122 - v126.Close
		local v130 = v126.Contact - v126.Close
		local v131 = v129 / math.max(v130, 0.001)
		return p119.angle * (1 - v131 ^ v_u_18.Close.Power)
	end
end
local function v_u_151(p133, p134) -- name: anomalyAngle
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_7
	local v135 = v_u_17.Cinema.Beats.Anomaly
	local v136 = v_u_18.Anomaly
	local v137 = p134.t
	if p134.act == "A1" then
		local v138 = v135.A1
		local v139 = v136.KnockBack.Degrees
		local v140 = v_u_13.wobble(v137 - v138.KnockBack, v136.KnockBack)
		local v141 = v139 * math.abs(v140)
		local v142 = v136.Open
		local v143 = v137 - v138.Open
		if v143 <= 0 then
			return v141
		else
			local v144 = v143 - v142.FirstSeconds - v142.Hesitate
			if v144 <= 0 then
				return v141 + v142.First * v_u_7.inOutCubic(v143 / v142.FirstSeconds)
			else
				return v141 + v142.First + (p133.anomalyAngle - v142.First) * v_u_7.inOutCubic(v144 / v142.Seconds)
			end
		end
	else
		if p134.act == "Pick" then
			return p133.anomalyAngle
		end
		local v145 = v135.A3
		if v137 < v145.Slam then
			return p133.anomalyAngle
		end
		if v137 >= v145.Contact then
			local v146 = v136.Slam.Bounce.Degrees
			local v147 = v_u_13.wobble(v137 - v145.Contact, v136.Slam.Bounce)
			return v146 * math.abs(v147)
		end
		local v148 = v137 - v145.Slam
		local v149 = v145.Contact - v145.Slam
		local v150 = v148 / math.max(v149, 0.001)
		return p133.anomalyAngle * (1 - v150 ^ v136.Slam.Power)
	end
end

function v_u_23.flicker(p155) -- name: flicker
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_19
	if p155.variant == "Anomaly" and p155.act == "A3" then
		local v156 = v_u_17.Cinema.Beats.Anomaly.A3
		local v157 = p155.t
		if v157 < v156.Flicker then
			return 1
		else
			local v158 = v_u_19.Cold.Flicker
			if v156.LightBack <= v157 then
				local v159 = (v157 - v156.LightBack) / v158.Return
				local v160 = math.clamp(v159, 0, 1)
				return v160 * v160 * (3 - v160 * 2)
			else
				local v161 = 1
				for _, v162 in v158.Steps do
					if v157 - v156.Flicker < v162[1] then
						continue
					end
					v161 = v162[2]
				end
				return v161
			end
		end
	else
		return 1
	end
end

local function v_u_399(p392, p393) -- name: stepWord
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_7

		p392.stop()
		p392.anchor:Destroy()
		return false
	end
	p392.scale(0.35 + 0.65 * v_u_7.outBack(v395 / v394.In))
	local v396 = p392.fade
	local v397 = (v395 - (v394.Seconds - v394.Fade)) / v394.Fade
	local v398 = math.clamp(v397, 0, 1)
	v396(v398 * v398 * (3 - v398 * 2))

local function v_u_410(p_u_400) -- name: stepKnock
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_118, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_391, (copy) v_u_399, (copy) v_u_26
	local v401 = v_u_18.Rap
	local v402 = os.clock()
	local v403 = v402 - p_u_400.at
	if not p_u_400.claimed then
		v_u_23.swing(p_u_400.shape, v403 >= v401.Runs and 0 or v_u_118(v403))
	end
	for v404, v405 in v401.Hits do
		if p_u_400.done[v404] or v405 > v403 then
			continue
		end
		p_u_400.done[v404] = true
		if v403 - v405 > (v_u_17.Cinema.Late or 0.3) or v403 >= v401.Runs then
			continue
		end
		p_u_400.dust:Emit(v_u_18.Dust.Count)
		local v406 = table.find(v_u_18.Words.On, v404)
		if not v406 then
			continue
		end
		local v407 = p_u_400.words
		local v408 = v_u_391(p_u_400.holder, p_u_400.shape, v406, p_u_400.at + v405)
		table.insert(v407, v408)
	end
	for v409 = #p_u_400.words, 1, -1 do
		if v_u_399(p_u_400.words[v409], v402) then
			continue
		end
		table.remove(p_u_400.words, v409)
	end
	if v401.Runs <= v403 then
		p_u_400.claimed = true
		if #p_u_400.words == 0 then
			p_u_400.connection:Disconnect()
			if v_u_26[p_u_400.shape.door] == p_u_400 then
				v_u_26[p_u_400.shape.door] = nil
			end
			task.delay(v_u_18.Dust.Lifetime + 0.1, function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_400
				p_u_400.folder:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_556(p539, p540) -- name: candleShares
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_7

	local v542 = v_u_17.Cinema.Beats.Anomaly

		local v543 = p540.t - v542.A1.CandleOut

		local v546 = math.clamp(v545, 0, 1)

	end
	local v547 = p540.act ~= "A3" and -1 or p540.t - v542.A3.Relight

		return 0, 0
	end

	local v550 = 1 - v548.Peak
	local v551 = v547 - v548.PeakAt
	local v552 = v548.Seconds - v548.PeakAt

end

local function v_u_305(p_u_283, p284, p_u_285) -- name: finish
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_45, (copy) v_u_12
	if not p_u_283.over then
		local v286 = v_u_9.TrickOrTreat.Bowl
		local v_u_287 = v286.Hud
		local v288 = v286.Sounds
		p_u_283.over = p284
		p_u_283.overAt = p_u_285
		p_u_283.wobbleAtOver = p_u_283.wobble()
		for _, v289 in p_u_283.connections do
			v289:Disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(p_u_283.connections)
		p_u_283.cursorOn(false)
		local v290 = p_u_283.hint
		if v290 and not v290.outAt then
			v290.outAt = p_u_285
		end
		if p_u_283.hovered then
			p_u_283.hovered = nil
			local v291 = p_u_283.bowl.hover
			if type(v291) == "function" then
				pcall(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_283
					p_u_283.bowl:hover(nil)
				end)
			end
		end
		if p284 == "Time" then
			local v292 = p_u_283.digit
			if v292() ~= "0" then
				v292("0")
			end
			p_u_283.trackFlashAt = p_u_285
			p_u_283.bannerAt = p_u_285
			p_u_283.bannerKind = "TimeUp"
			local v293 = p_u_283.bannerText
			local v294 = v_u_287.TimeUp.Text
			if v293() ~= v294 then
				v293(v294)
			end
			local v295 = p_u_283.bannerRotation
			local v296 = v_u_287.TimeUp.Tilt
			if v295() ~= v296 then
				v295(v296)
			end
			p_u_283.timeUpRing = v_u_15.play(v288.TimeUp.Sound, nil, {
				["volume"] = v288.TimeUp.volume,
				["pitch"] = v288.TimeUp.pitch
			})
			local v297 = p_u_285 + v_u_287.TimeUp.RingStop
			local function v298()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_15, (copy) p_u_283, (copy) v_u_287
				v_u_15.stop(p_u_283.timeUpRing, v_u_287.TimeUp.RingFade)
				p_u_283.timeUpRing = nil
			end
			local v299 = p_u_283.later
			table.insert(v299, {
				["at"] = v297,
				["run"] = v298
			})
			if p_u_283.badgeSpring then
				p_u_283.badgeSpring({
					["impulse"] = v_u_45(v_u_287.TimeUp.Badge - 1)
				})
			end
			if p_u_283.countSpring then
				p_u_283.countSpring({
					["impulse"] = v_u_45(v_u_287.TimeUp.CountKick - 1)
				})
				return
			end
		elseif p284 == "Empty" then
			p_u_283.bannerAt = p_u_285
			p_u_283.bannerKind = "AllGone"
			local v300 = p_u_283.bannerText
			local v301 = v_u_287.AllGone.Text
			if v300() ~= v301 then
				v300(v301)
			end
			local v302 = p_u_283.bannerRotation
			local v303 = v_u_287.AllGone.Tilt
			if v302() ~= v303 then
				v302(v303)
			end
			local v304 = v288.AllGone
			v_u_15.play(v304.Sound, nil, {
				["volume"] = v304.volume,
				["pitch"] = v304.pitch
			})
			v_u_12.pulse(v286.Haptics.AllGone)
			pcall(function()
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_283, (copy) p_u_285
				p_u_283.bowl:celebrate(p_u_285)

local function v_u_500(p464, p465, p466) -- name: stepTitle
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_276
	local v467 = v_u_9.TrickOrTreat.Bowl.Hud.Title
	local v468 = p464.titleAt
	if v468 and (p465 >= v468 and not p464.titleDone) then
		local v469 = p465 - v468
		local v470 = v469 / v467.In
		local v471 = math.clamp(v470, 0, 1)

		local v474 = 1 - math.clamp(v473, 0, 1)
		local v475

		end

				p464.titleDone = true

					v479(false)
				end
				return
			end
			local v480 = v478 * v478
			local v481 = p464.screen
			if v481 then
				v481 = v481:FindFirstChild("Root")
			end
			local v482 = v_u_24.scale()
			local v483

			else

			end

			else

			end

			v476 = (v_u_276(p464) - v488) * v480
			v472 = v472 * (1 + (v467.ZipTo - 1) * v480)
			v474 = math.max(v474, v480)
		end

		end

		end

		end

		local v499 = v495() - v498
		if math.abs(v499) > 0.001 then
			v495(v498)
		end
	end
end

function v_u_31.step(p719, p720, p721) -- name: step
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_270, (copy) v_u_500, (copy) v_u_563, (copy) v_u_641, (copy) v_u_393, (copy) v_u_718, (copy) v_u_8
	local v722 = v_u_9.TrickOrTreat.Bowl.Hud
	v_u_270(p719, p721)
	if #p719.later > 0 then
		local v723 = {}
		for v724 = #p719.later, 1, -1 do
			if p719.later[v724].at > p720 then
				continue
			end
			local v725 = table.remove
			local v726 = p719.later
			table.insert(v723, v725(v726, v724))
		end
		table.sort(v723, function(p727, p728)
			return p727.at < p728.at
		end)
		for _, v729 in v723 do
			v729.run()
		end
	end
	v_u_500(p719, p720, p721)
	v_u_563(p719, p720)
	v_u_641(p719, p720, p721)
	v_u_393(p719, p720, p721)
	v_u_718(p719, p720, p721)
	p719.steppedAt = p720
	local v730 = v722.Float
	for _, v731 in p719.pops do
		local v732 = p720 - v731.startAt
		if not v731.float.gui.Enabled then
			continue
		end
		if v730.Seconds <= v732 then
			v731.float.gui.Enabled = false
		else
			local v733 = v731.float.scale
			local v734 = v730.From
			local v735 = 1 - v730.From
			local v736 = v_u_8.outBack
			local v737 = v732 / v730.Pop
			v733(v734 + v735 * v736((math.clamp(v737, 0, 1))))
			local v738 = v731.float.gui
			local v739 = v730.Rise * v_u_8.outCubic(v732 / v730.Seconds)
			v738.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, v739, 0)
			local v740 = v731.float.transparency

			v740((math.clamp(v741, 0, 1)))
		end
	end
	p719.flight:step(p720, p721)
	return p719.over
end

local function v_u_198(p186, p187, p188) -- name: stepPad
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_153, (copy) v_u_149, (copy) v_u_24, (copy) v_u_8
	if p186.vanishing then
		local v189 = (p188 - p186.startedAt) / v_u_24.VanishSeconds
		if v189 >= 1 then
			for _, v190 in p186.parts do
				v190.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				for _, v191 in v190:GetChildren() do
					if not v191:IsA("Decal") then
						continue
					end
					v191.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			end
			return true
		else
			if v189 < 0.22 then
				v_u_149(p186, 1 + 0.12 * v_u_8.outCubic(v189 / 0.22), 0)
			else
				local v192 = (v189 - 0.22) / 0.78
				local v193 = v_u_149
				local v194 = 1.12 * (1 - v192 * v192)
				v193(p186, math.max(v194, 0.02), 0.35 * v192)
			end
			return false
		end
	else
		local v195 = p186.spring:step(p187)
		local v196 = v195 - 1
		if math.abs(v196) < 0.003 then
			local v197 = p186.spring.velocity
			if math.abs(v197) < 0.02 then
				v_u_153(p186)
				return true
			end
		end
		v_u_149(p186, math.max(v195, 0.02), 0)
		return false
	end
end

local function v_u_331(p304, p305) -- name: stepReveal
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_66, (copy) v_u_63, (copy) v_u_61, (copy) v_u_65, (copy) v_u_222, (copy) v_u_25, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_26

	local v308 = p304.frames

			continue
		end

			v309 = true
		else

			else

			end

			table.insert(v307, v319)

			if v310.paint then
				v320 = v_u_222(v310, v312)

				v320 = v321(v322 - Vector3.new(0, v323, 0)) * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(v310.axis, v310.tilt * v312) * v310.rest.Rotation
			end

			["pitch"] = v330.pitch
		})
	end

end

		v_u_21:Disconnect()
		v_u_21 = nil
	end
	if v_u_22 then
		v_u_22:Disconnect()
		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor
	v_u_20 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)
		if p31 == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

function configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43) -- name: configureAnimationSet

			v44:disconnect()

	v_u_17[p_u_42] = {}
	v_u_17[p_u_42].count = 0

	local v_u_45 = true
	local function v46()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_45

			local v58 = v53.Changed
			table.insert(v57, v58:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43

			end))
			local v59 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v60 = v53.ChildAdded
			table.insert(v59, v60:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
			local v61 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v62 = v53.ChildRemoved
			table.insert(v61, v62:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))

	if v_u_17[p_u_42].count <= 0 then

end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v102 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v102 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v102
end
local function v_u_108(p103) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14
	local v104 = p103 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v105 = 0.0001
	local v106 = 0.0001
	local v107 = 1
	if v104 <= 0.5 then
		v107 = v104 / 0.5
		v105 = 1
	elseif v104 < 1 then
		v106 = (v104 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v105 = 1 - v106
	else
		v107 = v104 / 1
		v106 = 1
	end
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v105)
	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v106)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v107)
	v_u_14:AdjustSpeed(v107)
end

function rollAnimation(p114) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v115 = math.random(1, v_u_17[p114].totalWeight)
	local v116 = 1
	while v_u_17[p114][v116].weight < v115 do
		v115 = v115 - v_u_17[p114][v116].weight
		v116 = v116 + 1
	end
	return v116
end

function onRunning(p142) -- name: onRunning
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_91, (copy) v_u_2, (ref) v_u_90, (ref) v_u_99, (ref) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_9
	local v143 = getHeightScale()
	if v_u_91 ~= nil and v_u_2.EvaluateStateMachine == false then
		local v144 = v_u_2.RootPart
		local v145 = v_u_91.SensedPart
		if v145 then
			local v146 = v145:GetVelocityAtPosition(v_u_91.HitFrame.Position)
			local v147 = v144.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local v148 = v147.X - v146.X
			local v149 = v147.Z - v146.Z
			local v150 = Vector3.new(v148, 0, v149).Magnitude
			local v151 = v_u_90.MovingDirection.Magnitude
			if v151 < 0.1 then
				v150 = 0
				v151 = 0
			elseif v151 > 1 then
				v151 = 1
			end
			p142 = v150 * v151
		end
	end
	local v152 = v_u_99
	if v152 then
		v152 = v_u_2.MoveDirection == Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	end
	if (v152 and (v_u_2.WalkSpeed / v143 or 0.75) or 0.75) * v143 < p142 then
		playAnimation("walk", 0.2, v_u_2)
		setAnimationSpeed(p142 / 16)
		v_u_3 = "Running"
	elseif v_u_19[v_u_9] == nil and not v_u_99 then
		playAnimation("idle", 0.2, v_u_2)
